_doc: Source list for scripts/fetch-audio.mjs (npm run audio:fetch). Every shipped sound effect that is a real recording is built from CC0 / public-domain packs listed in `packs`.

packs[id]: name, page (licence page), url (direct download), file (cache file name), kind zip|7z|file, author, license, licenseNote, verified. Only verified CC0 / Public Domain packs are accepted by the script.

entries[]: one per manifest key. items = layers mixed together: {pack, file (path inside the pack), start/dur (seconds, cut), gain (dB), at (seconds, delay), pitch (semitones, tape style), hp/lp (Hz)}.

Entry options: hp (master high-pass, default 90 Hz for phone speakers), lp, echo (ffmpeg aecho args, small room/stairwell), eq, trimDb (silence threshold, default -42), fadeInMs, fadeOutMs, sr (22050 default), peakDb (default -3.6), loop {seconds, xfade, start}, volume (manifest volume).
Processing order and the exact ffmpeg chain are documented at the top of scripts/fetch-audio.mjs. Fields edits / measured are written back by the script.
Downloaded files are untrusted data and are only decoded by ffmpeg / unzip / 7z. Wikimedia Commons was rate limited (HTTP 429) during research and nothing was taken from it.
